visualReview.method: Both reviewers actually viewed all24 full1600x1000 native PNG, complete contact sheet and eight-frame delivery preview from the same final native pass.
findings: Native book, altar outputs, armor inventory and Curios views belong to the actual paid route; all24 full frames were viewed.
Paid vanilla-tool effect scenes, worn Fortress modifications and the native light/ripple frames were inspected in full.
Captions remain outside original gameplay pixels; no generated artwork or composited game state.
limits: Prepared Survival fixtures supply strict predecessors, raw knowledge/materials/essentia/aura/arena and previous-stage items.
Screenshots supplement exact native payment, effect and ownership assertions; they alone do not prove every transaction.
Controlled actor attributes and owned-server positioning are explicit QA fixtures.
No full Survival, independent multiplayer, reload, arbitrary addon matrix, every pose/angle or audible sound proof.
independentFindings: All three completed Thaumonomicon study pages have readable body text within parchment columns, stage2/2 state, intact icons/tabs and no technical developer labels.
All eight paid vanilla tools show the expected distinct gold infusion names with readable ordinary item/attack-stat tooltips and intact textures.
Paid fortress cuirass and mundane ring show Runic shield+1; the native Curios view shows the ring equipped, fortress gear and the golden absorption HUD.
Worn goggles and all three mask variants show their distinct tooltip lines with goggles retained. The Angry Ghost capture preserves actual post-hit camera displacement and a reduced-heart HUD.

Native effect frames show physical mined items, the remaining lower logs, an actual Refining cluster, combat aftermath drops/particles, the Sounding scene and light reaching the walls/floor of the enclosed Lamplight room.

Both overview sheets contain the expected final-run images in coherent order; captions remain outside gameplay pixels. No missing-texture checkerboard, clipped tooltip text or blocking layout defect was found.
independentLimits: Hover tooltips cover much of the inventory avatar face in helmet and Curios scenes. These images establish displayed names/state and visible portions only; they do not establish every faceplate surface, viewing angle or pose.
Single screenshots capture selected animation instants, including combat aftermath; they do not prove every arc/ripple frame, timing sequence, sound or full TC6 visual parity.
Exact payments, typed output, source conservation, shield credits and native effects rely on separately bound native assertions/logs; image review is complementary evidence.

Strict research parents, raw theory/materials/essentia, stable altars, initial aura/terrain and bounded controlled actors are declared fixtures. Full Survival progression, independent multiplayer, save/reload, arbitrary modded tool/Curios combinations and full WarpEvents are not established.
